loops.operand_stats: Reflected CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3, poly 0xEDB88320, CRC_START_32=0xFFFFFFFF, final XOR 0xFFFFFFFF), byte-at-a-time table-driven. Per iteration: 1 unsigned byte load (lbu) from a sequential, unit-stride input stream (*ptr++); 32-bit crc state; index = (crc ^ byte) & 0xFF (8-bit index); 1 table load of a 32-bit word from the 256-entry x 4-byte (1 KiB) read-only crc_tab32 (data-dependent, random-access gather); crc>>8 logical shift; 1 XOR combine. Strict loop-carried recurrence through crc (each table index depends on the previous crc), so the chain is load-use latency bound: xor -> andi -> slli/add (address) -> lw -> srli/xor. No other memory writes. Called 1200 times per profile run; trip count = num_bytes, set by harness (not visible in sources). Candidate for a fused CRC32 step instruction (byte or word granularity, e.g. carry-less multiply / Zbc clmul-style or dedicated crc32.b/crc32.w) eliminating the table lookup.
